question: Was there a standing inquisitorial body?
proposition: There may have been a formal body (majlis-i tafaḥḥuṣ u dīvān-i tajassus) that tried Ibn Turka's three trials.
reasoning: Ṭūsī mentions such a body interrogating Hurufis; MK presumes it also handled Ibn Turka.
Both ‘may have been’ and ‘presumably’ are MK's hedges.
